segment_captions.caption: C picks up a small packet from the table and opens it with her hands while sitting at the table. A bowl of strawberries and a glass bowl are on the table.
C picks up a small packet from the table and opens it with her hands while looking down at the contents.
C picks up a small object from the table with her right hand while looking down at it.
C walks away from the table towards the kitchen area, holding a small object in her right hand.
C walks towards the couch, picks up a gift wrapped in red ribbon, and places it on the couch.
C walks towards the couch, then turns back towards the wall.
